phase_name: Classification Quality - embedded ML on a measured benchmark

Hybrid decision boundary.question: Which embedded JVM classification library should TidyMail use?
Hybrid decision boundary.answer: Use Tribuo as the primary candidate, subject to benchmark proof that it beats the deterministic baseline.

Hybrid decision boundary.question: What should happen when model confidence is low?
Hybrid decision boundary.answer: Classify the sender as Other so the user can re-categorize it.

Hybrid decision boundary.question: Which decisions may the ML model make?
Hybrid decision boundary.answer: ML predicts sender category only. Deterministic safety rules continue to decide risk and cleanup recommendations.

Hybrid decision boundary.question: What precedence and fallback rules apply?
Hybrid decision boundary.answer: Account-local manual corrections override model output. Deterministic rules remain the fallback when no qualifying model is available.
options_presented: Manual correction then model then rules fallback
